reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I told her the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. is noted as unverified, and I didn't record it anywhere as a confirmed date.

I couldn't check it against anything. The files Pree can see don't include a Brackenwater contract, CRM record or account profile. The Central team files I read (cheat sheet, January handoffs, Hollis's territory plan) don't mention Brackenwater either, and I didn't look outside what Pree can see.

I suggested she get the date confirmed in writing by the customer, or check it against the signed contract, before treating it as official. I offered to help update the account record once it's confirmed.

A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so posting it in the team channel was fine and needed no approval.
